entities.summary: The University of France was a highly centralized educational state organization founded by Napoleon I in 1806 and given authority over both the individual universities and also primary and secondary education. The former individual universities were henceforth to be known as "academies", but each still retained a rector and local board of its own. The University of France was disbanded in 1896.
